products.name: ADICOLOR CLASSICS TREFOIL TEE
products.description: A CASUAL TEE WITH BIG ADIDAS ENERGY. The Trefoil logo is steeped in sport and style history. But it's about more than that. It represents a fearless energy and a clan of creators striving to be their best at every step. Slip into the comfort of this adidas t-shirt and show it off. By buying cotton products from us, you're supporting more sustainable cotton farming.

A COMFORTABLE TEE INSPIRED BY THE ARCHIVES. Archival cut lines highlighted with piping details give this adidas t-shirt its effortlessly cool retro style. From lounging around at home to getting food with friends, you'll be comfortable all day long in soft cotton. A Trefoil logo brings the look home for an everyday staple that is anything but ordinary. Our cotton products support more sustainable cotton farming.
products.name: ADICOLOR SEASONAL ARCHIVE TEE

products.description: STYLISH, LOOSE-FITTING HOODIE WITH A KANGAROO POUCH DESIGN. Celebrate love in all its forms with the Valentine's Day Future Lounge selection. Clashing reds and pinks invite you to share the love, while bold slogans and cozy designs make it easy to spread feel-good vibes on V-Day and beyond. From me-time to we-time — the Valentine's Day Hoodie is designed to go the distance. The stylish yet laidback design is ideal for outdoor link ups and hardcore lounging alike, while the soft French Terry fabric adds a heavyweight feel for that unique loungewear feeling. A certified wardrobe favorite for you (and all the other hoodie lovers in your life).
products.name: VALENTINE'S DAY HOODIE
FUTURE ICONS 3-STRIPES SHORTS
products.description: Train like a champ, then rest like one in these soft adidas shorts. The cotton and polyester doubleknit fabric is thick and cosy. The elastic drawcord waist rests smoothly against your skin, but can be tightened if you do have to leave the couch. Just pair with slip-on sneakers for a totally hassle-free look. Made in part with recycled content generated from production waste, eg. cutting scraps, and post-consumer household waste to avoid the larger environmental impact of producing virgin content.

products.name: ADICOLOR CLASSICS SPORTS SHORTS
products.description: TENNIS-INSPIRED SHORTS MADE IN PART WITH RECYCLED CONTENT. There is no denying the tennis influence on these adidas shorts. From the fit to the ultra-soft towel terry material, they have everything you need to look the part, without actually doing a thing. All you'll do in these shorts? Be comfortable. (Okay, sure, you'll probably do more than that, but the point is you don't need to.) Made in part with recycled content generated from production waste, e.g. cutting scraps, and post-consumer household waste to avoid the larger environmental impact of producing virgin content.

products.name: ARGENTINA TIRO 23 HOODIE
products.description: A SOFT HOODIE FOR ARGENTINA FANS, MADE IN PART WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. When the biggest prizes are in your sights, focus is everything. This adidas football hoodie keeps Argentina's players comfortable when they're relaxing at the training ground. Moisture-wicking AEROREADY, soft French terry fabric and a lined hood make it easy to tune everything out during your downtime, so you can hit the pitch with renewed purpose. Made with a series of recycled materials, and at least 60% recycled content, this product represents just one of our solutions to help end plastic waste.

products.name: PARMA 16 SHORTS
products.description: MOISTURE-WICKING SHORTS FOR FOOTBALL TRAINING. Awe-inspiring moments don't happen in the match unless you put in the time to train. Hone your striking and ball-handling skills in these lightweight football shorts. Not only does the fabric keep you dry, it's also made using recycled materials to help end plastic waste.

products.name: ARGENTINA TIRO 23 DOWNTIME SHORTS
products.description: WOVEN SHORTS CREATED FOR RELAXING AND MADE WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. When the biggest prizes are in your sights, focus is everything. That means relaxation should be taken as seriously as hard work. While they're kicking back between training sessions, Argentina players pull on adidas football shorts like these ones. Pockets on the sides provide storage for valuables. That embroidered badge shows you consider yourself part of the squad. Made with 100% recycled materials, this product represents just one of our solutions to help end plastic waste.

A SOFT HOODIE FOR ARGENTINA FANS. Argentina DNA. 3-Stripes style. Show your appreciation for first-class football in this adidas hoodie. Created to keep you comfortable while you rep your team, this French terry top has an adjustable hood and deep kangaroo pockets. That golden embroidered badge is the star of the show. Our cotton products support more sustainable cotton farming.
products.name: ARGENTINA 3-STRIPES FULL-ZIP HOODIE
TERREX MULTI TEE
products.description: A QUICK-DRYING TEE FOR TRAIL OR GYM, MADE WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. The workout t-shirt, reinvented. This adidas Terrex Multi Tee is made with moisture-managing AEROREADY to keep you dry and focused, whether you're hiking, running, or hitting the gym. Offset shoulder seams reduce chafing under a backpack, and an extended back hem adds coverage where you need it.

products.name: INDIGO HERZ FUR HOODIE
products.description: A COZY FAUX FUR HOODIE INSPIRED BY INDIGO HERZ. Welcome to a new age of originality. Inspired by the adidas Originals-owned NFT, the Indigo Herz Drop is an invitation to self-express without limitations. No matter which world you're in. Hoodies are comfy, but even great things can get better. The adidas Indigo Herz Fur Hoodie levels up the cozy factor with faux fur that's inspired by its namesake and peach-soft to the touch. Classic details — like a hood and the iconic 3-Stripes — create a signature silhouette that easily pairs with everything in your wardrobe.

products.name: OWN THE RUN SEASONAL TEE
products.description: A MOISTURE-ABSORBING TEE MADE WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. Your everyday t-shirt doesn't have to look or feel basic. This classic adidas crewneck tee is made from 100% recycled polyester mesh, which makes for a super-breathable shirt and a cooler run on a hot day. Stay dry and comfortable with moisture-absorbing AEROREADY. Reflective details add shine after sunset. Made with 100% recycled materials, this product represents just one of our solutions to help end plastic waste.

MODERN RETRO RUNNING SHOES MADE IN PART WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. Celebrate the '70s in these adidas runners, and pay homage to a time when polyester suits were in and shag carpets were so thick you could do snow angels in them. The leather upper in this snappy rework of those running classics takes you back to the "me decade," no disco dancing required. 3-Stripes and adidas graphics on the tongue and heel tab complete the look.
products.name: RUN 70S LIFESTYLE RUNNING SHOES

products.description: VERSATILE SHOES WITH A SPRINGY FEEL, MADE IN PART WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. Go for that walk around the neighbourhood or head to the gym in a pair of adidas Alphabounce+ shoes. The mesh upper is soft and breathable to keep you comfortable as you go. A Bounce midsole makes the ride soft and springy while Cloudfoam on the heel cushions every step, so you can cruise smoothly through the day.
products.name: ALPHABOUNCE+ SUSTAINABLE BOUNCE SHOES
DURAMO 10 SHOES
products.description: DAILY-WEAR RUNNING SHOES, MADE IN PART WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. From a morning gym session to a day of errands to an evening with friends, keep your feet comfortable and your style on point in these adidas shoes. Pair them with your favourite running shorts for the ultimate athletic-casual vibe. A mesh upper helps you stay cool, while superlight cushioning cradles every step you take. Made with a series of recycled materials, this upper features at least 50% recycled content. This product represents just one of our solutions to help end plastic waste.

products.description: TWO ICONS OF THE BEAUTIFUL GAME, ONE ICONIC PARTNERSHIP. THE CLUB OF THE CENTURY, AL AHLY, MEETS ADIDAS. THE AWAY KIT COMES IN A SLEEK BLACK LOOK THAT THE EGYPTIAN GIANTS WILL WEAR FOR THEIR MATCHES OUTSIDE OF THEIR HOME GROUND. WORKING HARD TO WICK MOISTURE FROM YOUR SKIN, AEROREADY ENSURES YOU'RE ALWAYS READY FOR MORE. MADE WITH 100% RECYCLED MATERIALS, THIS PRODUCT REPRESENTS JUST ONE OF OUR SOLUTIONS TO HELP END PLASTIC WASTE.

products.description: THESE ADIDAS X ANDRÉ SARAIVA SHORTS ARE MADE WITH NATURE. Last season, adidas x André Saraiva showcased a sustainable story centred around a love for our planet. This season tells the story of a "Love Union," sharing a message of hope for Valentine's Day. Through the timeless medium of graffiti, André promotes the mantra "The World Needs Love" to encourage acceptance amongst us all. The love is hard to miss with bold and vibrant graphics on these juniors' adidas shorts. Wherever you wear them, soft cotton cradles you in comfort. These shorts are made with natural and renewable materials as part of our journey to design out finite resources and help end plastic waste.
products.name: ADIDAS ORIGINALS X ANDRÉ SARAIVA SHORTS

products.description: A ZIP-UP HOODIE WITH SPORT-INSPIRED COMFORT. What's your colour? This juniors' adidas zip-up hoodie comes in many. And while its slim fit and minimalist style make this your daily go-to before heading out the door, it's really the soft, buttery touch of its French terry fabric that has you jumping for joy. This product is made with recycled content as part of our ambition to end plastic waste.
products.name: ADIDAS ESSENTIALS FULL-ZIP HOODIE

products.description: A HOODIE-AND-PANTS JOGGER SET DONE UP IN VIBRANT COLOURS. An active life powers up our passions and pushes us past the impossible. Good thing your little one is always on the move. This infants' adidas two-piece jogger set is made of soft French terry for snuggle-worthy comfort. If it gets chilly, the lined hood keeps the cold from creeping in. By buying cotton products from us, you're supporting more sustainable cotton farming. This product is also made with recycled content as part of our ambition to end plastic waste.

products.description: A PADDED JACKET THAT TRANSFORMS INTO A VEST, MADE WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS. LEGO® bricks teach us that we can build what we can imagine. Take that mentality into your every day in this juniors' 2-in-1 jacket that's part of the LEGO Group and adidas collection. Detachable sleeves give you two ways to wear it — as a classic jacket or a sleeveless vest. Synthetic insulation holds heat close to keep you warm as you flow through cold days. Made with a series of recycled materials and 100% recycled content.
products.name: ADIDAS X CLASSIC LEGO® 2-IN-1 PADDED JACKET

products.description: A SOFT BODYSUIT, MADE IN PART WITH RECYCLED CONTENT. Dress your little one in this adidas x LEGO® bodysuit for infants and nurture a sense of wonder, creativity and play in them right from the get-go. The soft French terry build lets them crawl and climb in comfort. When their day is done and bath time comes, the snap button front makes taking it off a breeze. Made in part with recycled content generated from production waste, e.g. cutting scraps, and post-consumer household waste to avoid the larger environmental impact of producing virgin content. Our cotton products support more sustainable cotton farming.
products.name: ADIDAS X CLASSIC LEGO® BODYSUIT
